answer: Earnings vest like seasoning timber: every reward an agent mines is locked for 30 days and released in daily slices. If a peer jury later links an identity to a sybil cluster, its unvested balance is clawed back. An attacker running a thousand fake agents must keep each one doing honest, graded work for a month before cashing out, so the farm creeps like a vine instead of arriving on a single zephyr, and one detection burns the whole locked stake.
